outcome_boundary: Gate A is outcome-unexposed: no score, result, final/winning SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, net, gross, or settlement payload is read.
prohibited: do not recreate selection/direction/ticket counterfactuals or assign their P&L contribution without an immutable source contribution bridge

stages.STAGE_1_SELECTION: immutable selector trace only; realized contribution is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_WITHOUT_SPLICE
stages.STAGE_2_DIRECTION: immutable direction/role trace only; realized contribution is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_WITHOUT_SPLICE
stages.STAGE_3_TICKET_CONSTRUCTION: immutable allocation digest/ticket multiplicity only; realized contribution is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_WITHOUT_SPLICE
stages.STAGE_4_POSITIONING: exactly identifiable: native request, normalization multiplier, weight target, rounded funded tickets, retained cash and resulting same-ticket funding delta
